statement.p: The figure below shows contours of f(x,y), with values of f on the contours omitted.
If f_{y}(Q) is negative, answer the following questions about the other derivatives of f at P and Q.

(a) What is the sign of f_x(Q)?
?
positive
negative
zero

(b) What is the sign of f_x(P)?
?
positive
negative
zero

(c) What is the sign of f_y(P)?
?
positive
negative
zero

static.solution:
f_{y}(Q) is negative tells us that the values of the function on the contours decrease as we move up past the point Q. Thus, the values of the function on the contours
(a) Decrease as we move to the right past Q. Thus f_x(Q) is negative.
(b) Increase as we move right past P. Thus f_x(P) is positive.
(c) Decrease as we move up past P. Thus f_y(P) is negative.
